meaning:
ἀπειθέω, -ῶ
(ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;]
as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., Act.14:2 19:9, Rom.10:21 11:31 15:31, Heb.3:18 11:31, 1Pe.3:20; with dative, Jhn.3:36, Rom.2:8 11:30, 1Pe.2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: be of them that obey not

elsewhere.note: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
